task: Implement the complete ProofStory M0-M9 progressive intent hardening lifecycle for the Proofbound CLI.
outcome: After this story reaches DONE, the user can run ProofStory commands such as original_intent_snapshot_set, milestone_ledger_set, intent_collision_set, proofstory_gate_check, red_evidence_create, spike_start, and done_intent_equivalence_check, and see English diagnostics that prove intent coverage is captured, oversized ledgers are flagged before DEV, risk-triggered evidence is required only when appropriate, and enforcement can run in observe, warn, or enforce mode.
facts: Existing implementation only covers an M0-M2 MVP diagnostic surface in packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts and packages/main/src/handlers/proofstory.ts.
The approved design keeps the Story container but treats the ProofStory gate as the true DEV entry for triggered work.
Milestone ledgers are intent coverage artifacts, not execution plans; oversized ledgers must produce slice-plan diagnostics instead of automatic child-story creation.
intent_coverage_check must run after checklist, verificationIntent, and acceptance binding exist; early ledger checks are only confirmation and sizing diagnostics.
The rollout must stay progressive: observe and warn by default, enforce only when policy or explicit mode requires it.

Existing lifecycle entry points are transition-orchestrator.ts, core/machine.ts canStartDevGuard/canPassReviewGuard/canFinishGuard, and phase-gates.ts preflight helpers; ProofStory can integrate there without a second state machine.
constraints: Do not create a second lifecycle state machine; integrate with existing Lattice gates and diagnostics.
Keep ordinary single-outcome stories lightweight with an Intent MVP.
Do not make red evidence or spike evidence mandatory for every story.
All new user-facing command text, docs, and code comments for this feature must be in English.
Do not implement automatic child story scheduling in this story; only emit slicing diagnostics.
